summary: P01 V2.47.234 fixes the Owner-reported category creation visibility defect: selecting 一级分类 already persisted parent_id=null correctly, but new 0-item active categories were hidden from the Owner Navigation tree by the public empty-category suppression rule. Owner Navigation and Owner mobile Navigation now show all active categories including empty new categories, while public Navigation may continue hiding empty categories. Sort/display parity and UX-49 contracts are reconciled accordingly. No Schema/Migration, no second Category Authority, no auth/session/security semantic change, no updater mechanism change, no provider/server write and no Production write. Production remains Owner-manual.
